Hi Tim —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side based on what we covered: 

1) SOC 2 / Compliance
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our inference platform in 2025 (see attached executive summary). Happy to surface the full report under NDA.
- We support GDPR controls and can sign Data Processing Agreements; HIPAA/BAA support is available for customers in scope (we have standard BAA language and controls we can share).

2) Encryption & KMS
- In transit: all traffic to hosted APIs is protected with TLS 1.2+; Private deployments can be configured with mutual TLS where required.
- At rest: model artifacts and persisted data are encrypted with AES-256.
- Customer-managed keys (CMEK/BYOK): options vary by deployment model:
  - Hosted (Redwood API): enterprise-tier customers can enable customer key wrapping via AWS KMS / GCP CMEK / Azure Key Vault integrations for data-at-rest keys in supported regions.
  - Dedicated: supports KMS integrations and can be configured to use customer-managed keys for storage volumes and backups.
  - Private (VPC / on-prem): full BYOK / HSM options — we can integrate with customer HSM or your KMS for complete key custody.

3) Vendor security questionnaire
- I attached our standard vendor security questionnaire PDF to speed things up. If you prefer, we can complete your portal directly (please send access or the contact).

Next steps I propose:
- Tim: confirm whether FinBank requires CMEK/BYOK for production (this will determine whether Hosted will be sufficient or if we should plan for Dedicated/Private).
- Marissa (cc’d): will provide a short technical note outlining Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private key custody differences and example architecture.
- Rachel (cc’d): will coordinate procurement / vendor portal access and timeline.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with Marissa to answer any HSM/KMS-specific questions.

Hi Tim & Sophia —

Thanks for the questions — quick technical responses below and a proposed next step to complete the vendor intake: 

Encryption & key management (short answers):
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ for all hosted endpoints. We also support mTLS for Private deployments or customer gateways.
- At rest: AES-256 encryption for object stores and persistent volumes; snapshots/backups are encrypted.
- Hosted (enterprise): supports customer-managed key wrapping where we integrate with your KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK / Azure Key Vault). Note: in Hosted we perform key wrapping (we do not place the tenant’s encryption keys directly on our cluster hardware) — for most customers this satisfies compliance requirements; we can share the exact key flow diagram upon request.
- Dedicated: supports KMS integrations for storage and backup; can be configured to leverage customer KMS with key rotation policies. HSM-backed keys are available depending on underlying cloud provider and region.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full BYOK and HSM integration — customer retains key custody and can enforce HSM-only key usage.

Evidence & timeline:
- SOC 2: we completed SOC 2 Type II for the inference service in Dec 2025 (auditor: RedAudits LLC). We can share the full report under NDA; the attached summary is the public executive summary.
- Vendor questionnaire: if you provide portal access (Tim/Sophia link above), we can complete the portal directly. Typical turnaround: 2–3 business days for the questionnaire, 3–5 business days if we need to pull additional artifacts under an NDA.
- Deployment timeline: Hosted + CMEK enablement: ~2–4 weeks after account setup. Dedicated with KMS/HSM: typically 6–10 weeks (depends on network, PSC, and key escrow policies). Private on-prem: timeline variable; we’ll need to align on provisioning and HSM handoff.

Next step I recommend: Camila/Rachel, please open the vendor portal link and grant Marissa access to upload the questionnaire and SOC 2 report under the FinBank vendor record. Marissa will then schedule a 30-min technical call to walk the FinBank security team through the key flow and provide architecture diagrams.

Let me know preferred times for the call and any specific evidence fields you need in the portal.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
